title: Child Session Result v1
description: Result packet produced by a completed child session. Contains mission summary, files changed, validation results, and recommended next action. The reviewer orchestrator consumes these to decide the next sprint decision.

mission_id.description: Mission identifier this result corresponds to.

session_id.description: Session identifier that executed the mission.

final_report_path.description: Path to the child session's final report.

artifact_manifest_path.description: Path to artifact manifest if artifacts were published.

checkpoint_commit_sha.description: Commit SHA if a checkpoint was created.

files_changed.description: List of file paths changed by the child session.

findings_recorded.description: Finding IDs recorded by the child session.

recommended_next_action.description: Recommended next action from the child session.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of result creation.

forbidden_fields.description: Field names that MUST NOT appear.
